blocks.text: 今天，我们发布 MiniMax H3-Image，这是一款基于 H3 构建的开源权重图像生成模型。它支持文生图、参考图生成和图像编辑。

inlines.text: 今天，我们发布 MiniMax H3-Image，这是一款基于 H3 构建的开源权重图像生成模型。它支持文生图、参考图生成和图像编辑。

blocks.text: H3-Image 能在 10 秒内生成一张 4K（4096 × 4096）图像，细节丰富逼真，提示词遵循能力强，并且能够理解和使用最多 16 张参考图。

blocks.text: 在 H3 预训练能力的基础上，我们对整个后训练流程做了改进，涵盖数据、强化学习、采样步数缩减、PE 和部署优化。

blocks.text: Today, we're releasing MiniMax H3-Image, an open-weight image generation model built on H3. It supports text-to-image generation, reference-based generation, and image editing.

inlines.text: Today, we're releasing MiniMax H3-Image, an open-weight image generation model built on H3. It supports text-to-image generation, reference-based generation, and image editing.

blocks.text: H3-Image can generate a 4K (4096 × 4096) image in under 10 seconds, with rich, realistic details, strong prompt adherence, the ability to understand and work with up to 16 reference image.

inlines.text: H3-Image can generate a 4K (4096 × 4096) image in under 10 seconds, with rich, realistic details, strong prompt adherence, the ability to understand and work with up to 16 reference image.

blocks.text: Building on H3's pre-training capabilities, we've made improvements across the entire post-training pipeline, from data and reinforcement learning to sampling-step reduction, PE, and deployment optimization.

inlines.text: Building on H3's pre-training capabilities, we've made improvements across the entire post-training pipeline, from data and reinforcement learning to sampling-step reduction, PE, and deployment optimization.

blocks.text: No single change made the difference. Together, these improvements allow H3-Image to deliver speed, image quality, and prompt adherence at the same time.

inlines.text: No single change made the difference. Together, these improvements allow H3-Image to deliver speed, image quality, and prompt adherence at the same time.
